# Synthetic binary fixtures

`word97.doc` was generated by macOS `textutil -convert doc` from synthetic UTF-8
paragraphs and tab-separated values. `book97.xls` was independently generated by
xlwt 1.3.0 with Chinese/English SST strings, multiple sheets, sparse rows, numbers,
booleans, an uncached formula, and a long SST entry crossing BIFF CONTINUE records.
They contain no owner chats, credentials, macros, or external links. Test-only
fixture generators are not runtime dependencies. Production parsing follows the
Microsoft MS-DOC/MS-XLS specifications, using the Apache-2.0-licensed mscfb container reader.
